RitualChecks.Name: Ritual Checks
RitualChecks.Hint: Adds ritual-rank selection and a shared chat workflow for secondary and primary ritual checks, including DCs, circumstance modifiers, degree reductions, and Hero Point rerolls.

RitualChecks.RerollHint: A Hero Point reroll replaces the previous result and recalculates the ritual before the primary check is rolled.
RitualChecks.NoChecksRecognized: No automated check could be recognized in the ritual text.

Notifications.GMRequired: An active GM is required to start a shared ritual workflow.
Notifications.NoEligibleCheck: No controlled caster has an eligible statistic for “{check}”.
